Waitress was dreadful, we had a great meal just around the corner at Lucky Restaurant
Mar 2020
It's a shame that 1 is the lowest rating we can give this place. In the height of the Corona virus we had to make a quick exit from Vietnam which was a great shame as we had found the people and places we had seen really nice. So, we rocked up at the airport 3 days into our 17 night holiday so not in the best of spirits. We found this place and had a quick look at the menu before deciding to take our seats. The waitress seemed to pay little to no attention to us as we manovered around the tables and chairs with our cases. Eventually, she came over and plonked two menus in front of us. We then said what we wanted and she just pointed to ALL of the items on the page we had chosen and said in a rather rude manner 'not available'. I understand that language can be a barrier but attitude needn't be. She seemed really 'put out' and hardly bothered about us as custmers. We then said we'd have a beer each. Again, another face pulling episode ensued. She needs a job which is not customer facing. Its at this point we'd had enough of her attitude and decided to go round to another restaurant called Lucky (it's just round the corner) and are we very glad we did. Both food and service were first class. Give it a try.
